Full list of closures as A52 project set to bring disruption to Derby and Nottingham drivers

Drivers travelling along the busy route will face disruption over the coming weeks

    National Highways has published a list of closures across the East Midlands as it continues a project that will see new LED lighting along the A52.

    The busy route is set for disruption between Derby and Nottingham, with work beginning earlier this week on Monday (October 12).

    The highways authority is working to retrofit most of the lighting across the region by March 2027, something that will reduce energy consumption by "up to 65 per cent".

    READ MORE: Full schedule of Prince Harry and Meghan's visit to 3 Nottingham venues

    READ MORE: Popular Nottingham shop on the move as it outgrows premises

    Drivers in Derby are currently facing one week of nighttime closures from the M1 J25 to Spondon westbound.

    Following this, there will be an "up and over" closure on the A52 westbound carriageway at J25 from Monday (October 26) to Thursday (October 29). This means traffic will be diverted a short distance along the slip roads where the A52 meets the M1.

    Works are also ongoing across Nottingham and Nottinghamshire, with lane closures in place around Wheatcroft Island - which itself will be subject to a full closure next weekend.

    From Friday (October 30) to Tuesday (November 10), the A52 will be closed overnight from Bardhills Roundabout to J25.

    You can see the full list of A52 closures below:

    Thursday, October 15 and Friday, October 16

    • Lane closures up to and including Wheatcroft Island in both directions – utility works (24 hrs)

    • Westbound carriageway closure from M1 junction 25 to Spondon Roundabout, including Cole Lane, Victoria Avenue & Borrowash Road – LED electrical works (8pm - 6am)

    • M1 junction 25 exit slip to A52 westbound closed - LED electrical works (8pm - 6am)

    • Eastbound and westbound lane closures between Bardills Roundabout to Priory Roundabout - survey works (8pm - 6am Thursday, until 8pm on Friday)

    Monday, October 19

    • Eastbound Dunkirk to Queens Drive Roundabout slip road and lane closures - maintenance works (9pm - 5am)

    • Lane closures up to and including Wheatcroft Island in both directions – utility works (from 6am Monday)

    • Westbound carriageway closure from M1 junction 25 to Spondon Roundabout, including Cole Lane, Victoria Avenue & Borrowash Road – LED electrical works (8pm - 6am)

    • M1 junction 25 exit slip to A52 westbound closed - LED electrical works (8pm - 6am)

    • Eastbound and westbound lane closures between Bardills Roundabout to Priory Roundabout - survey works (8pm - 6am)

    • Eastbound and westbound lane closures between Bramcote Island and Priory Roundabout - Cadent Gas works (8pm - 6am)

    Tuesday, October 20

    • Lane closures up to and including Wheatcroft Island in both directions – utility works (24 hrs)

    • Westbound carriageway closure from M1 junction 25 to Spondon Roundabout, including Cole Lane, Victoria Avenue & Borrowash Road – LED electrical works (8pm - 6am)

    • M1 junction 25 exit slip to A52 westbound closed - LED electrical works (8pm - 6am)

    • Eastbound Dunkirk to Queens Drive Roundabout slip road and lane closures - maintenance works (9pm - 5am)

    Wednesday, October 21

    • Lane closures up to and including Wheatcroft Island in both directions – utility works (24 hrs)

    • Westbound carriageway closure from M1 junction 25 to Spondon Roundabout, including Cole Lane, Victoria Avenue & Borrowash Road – LED electrical works (8pm - 6am)

    • M1 junction 25 exit slip to A52 westbound closed - LED electrical works (8pm - 6am)

    • Eastbound Dunkirk to Queens Drive Roundabout slip road and lane closures - maintenance works (9pm - 5am)
